no starburst confetti on every slide — one per section
no paper texture or distressed grain
no neon or cyber accents breaking the era

visual_elements.allowed: starbursts, boomerang arcs, atomic orbits, solid organic fills, thin-line vectors

rendering_constraints: Thin-line signature motifs on cream, harvest ramp only.
